title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Georgia
part_text: 4. Strongly opposes initiatives regarding individual restrictive measures or sanctions as a tool of unjustified foreign interference and political pressure; emphasises that political pressure and interference in the national judiciary undermine sovereign democratic processes and bilateral trust; calls on the EU Member States to prioritise constructive dialogue and mutual respect over unilateral actions that deepen polarisation and harm the long-term partnership between the EU and Georgia;
